title: Sharp Causal Ranges with Unsupported Shared Rows in Markovian Relational Causal Models
banked_reason: D0.5: tier=incremental < floor=field and NOT salvageable in scope; paper_score_ceiling 5.5 < 7.4.
gap_reasons: tier=incremental < floor=field (target=field) and NOT salvageable in scope

The TL;DR and project justification advertise a sound, complete, polynomial-size skeptical certificate, but Check is defined by saying that it verifies semantic conclusions such as incidence exhaustiveness, candidate exhaustiveness, exact algebraic links, and model validity; the soundness proof then infers those same conclusions from acceptance.

The cubic proposition does not deliver the promised independent producer/checker or a serialized certificate: it invokes the abstract completeness theorem and argues informally that malformed records would be rejected.

What remains proved is a narrow fully Markovian product-simplex image and endpoint-attainment result, routine univariate extremization, and a conservative coupling enclosure, with no delivered N3 certificate or application evidence.
proof_attempt_summary: The run derived an exact product-simplex image with finite-noise endpoint witnesses, specialized it to one-row univariate algebraic bounds, and added a multiplicative occurrence-coupling enclosure. The field-tier certificate headline collapsed because the checker remained a semantic specification rather than an executable verified grammar, while the cubic transaction and N3 artifact were not delivered; completing those items would still be artifact completion at subfield scale. A future field attempt must re-anchor around a compact circuit-level compiler/checker theorem or a structural frontier for tied relational mechanisms versus untied canonical relaxations.
tldr: For any finite family of target-relevant unsupported finite-categorical shared rows, the fully Markovian relational causal set is exactly the compact interval obtained as the image of an explicit rational polynomial over the product of row simplices, and both endpoints have common finite-noise type-shared RSCM witnesses. The one unsupported binary row remains the tractable specialization: derivative-root isolation gives exact algebraic endpoints and a skeptical certificate checks the complete relational instance and endpoint models with polynomial size and checking cost. The structural classes explicitly require mutually independent distinct exogenous variables, no exogenous relational parents, and no non-relational exogenous parent shared by distinct ground endogenous variables; they do not assume the comparator-only global parent-multiset bound. Ejaz--Bareinboim Definition 3.2 permits non-relational exogenous sharing only among attributes of the same instance, while their Section 5 neural-completeness domain is separate. On an instance in that domain, nonidentification transfers only under an explicit same-data, same-query class inclusion; neither the sharp interval nor singleton identification transfers to a strict superclass. Supported-row boxes use the multiplicative radius \(\delta_{\times}=1-\prod_r(1-\epsilon_r)^{m_r}\). The exhaustive assignment-level incidence grammar still has the stated treewidth-zero exponential obstruction.
gap: When the complete relational identification procedure returns \(\mathsf{FAIL}\), it does not report the exact compatible causal range; general discrete-SCM bounding and univariate algebra do not jointly certify the relational derivation of the objective, source reproduction, algebraic extrema, and endpoint models.
fill: The project proves the sharp image theorem, serializes common finite-noise endpoint RSCMs, and supplies a sound, complete certificate that binds and replays the complete fixed relational instance with polynomial size and checking cost, followed by an explicitly conservative sampling enclosure under separately stated representative-context positivity.
